automation_evidence.quote:
Open-TI is the first method capable of conducting exhaustive traffic analysis from scratch - spanning from map data acquisition to the
eventual execution in complex simulations.

summary: An LLM agent chains map, simulation, signal-control and O-D tools and a language-policy controller (ChatZero); evaluation shows lower API-call error rates than TrafficGPT and throughput/travel-time across four LLMs, with no task-score baseline or obstacle-targeted experiment.
